test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Suman incurred a loss of 35% on selling an article for Rs. 41275, What was the cost price of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of the article = Rs. 41275

The loss% = 35%

**Formula used:**

Loss = Cost price - Selling price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the article be X

⇒ ({1-{35over100}})times X=41275

⇒ ({{65over100}})times X=41275

⇒ ({{13over20}})times X=41275

⇒ X = 63500

**∴ The required result will be Rs. 63500.**
